layouts.guidance: Demonstrate robust top-edge traversal while avoiding central fires, staying on row 0 as long as possible and then descending along the final goal column to reach the bottom-right.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Reinforces staying on the top-edge corridor during fire placements and demonstrates safe descent to the goal, addressing fire-avoidance generalization in this corridor.
layouts.rationale: Classic top-edge traversal with central fires to force the agent to maintain the top-row path before descending to the goal.
